text:
elaine: FYI FinReg follow-up: they want an "access pack" showing SSO assertions, RBAC export, short account rotation note, and an MFA proof row. Need a single ZIP by EOD.

samir: I can do SAML/OIDC + MFA proof. Quick note: Hosted delegates auth to customer IdP, but we require MFA for org admins and record authn_context in audit events. I'll attach a sample AttributeStatement and a curl to pull the event.

morgan: I'll export an RBAC YAML and service-account guidance. Service accounts default to 1h tokens, can be constrained by prefix, and signing keys are KMS-backed with nightly rotation. Include an ops blurb.

harry: Session defaults: console idle=45m, interactive=60m, API token TTL=900s (refresh allowed). Breakglass requires 2 approvers and produces extra audit entries.

samir: Sample SAML attribute snippet:

```
<AttributeStatement>
  <Attribute Name=\"email\"><AttributeValue>${user.email}</AttributeValue></Attribute>
  <Attribute Name=\"groups\"><AttributeValue>${user.groups}</AttributeValue></Attribute>
  <Attribute Name=\"roles\"><AttributeValue>redwood:deployer</AttributeValue></Attribute>
</AttributeStatement>
```

morgan: RBAC example snippet we'll include:

```
roles:
  - id: viewer
    permissions: [models.read, logs.read]
service_accounts:
  - id: poc-runner
    scopes: [models.read]
    token_ttl_seconds: 3600
```

samir: To fetch MFA events (org-admin):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" "https://console.redwood/api/audit?filter=event:authentication.success AND mfa:true&since=48h"
```

infra-bot: export ready: /exports/finreg/access_pack_1765559999.zip (presigned link active 48h)

elaine: Great work. I'll review the ZIP and send to FinReg with a one-paragraph summary of rotation + revoke.
